'''Zukao''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was the brother of [[Fomadu]], with whom he shared a strong [[Force-bond/Legends|Force bond]]. However, Zukao perished during the [[Bpfassh Uprising]], and later Fomadu formed a new Force bond with a female [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] named [[Mei (Dark Jedi)|Mei]]. During the duel with Fomadu on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Obi-Wan Kenobi used a [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusion]] to briefly make himself look like Zukao after finding a cherished image in his opponent's mind. Fomadu was startled for a moment, and Kenobi managed to strike his opponent down.
